races.paceDynamic: Ten Sixty Six and Light The Night Up will set honest fractions from the outset, with both needing to lead to be effective. Box Clever, Spacewoman, Valkyrie Storm and Adba will create severe congestion in the prominent positions behind the leaders through the middle stages. The pace should be fair to strong given the dual pace angle, but the key tactical pressure comes from the prominent bottleneck. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the traffic and deliver late - Galileo Charm, Jamie Sommers, Reem Rak and Laughterintherain all benefit from staying out of trouble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get tangled up turning for home as expected
scenarios.body: The pace-setters weaken after their battle while the prominent brigade suffers interference. Clean hold-up runners sweep past tired leaders with clear runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners stay clear
scenarios.trigger: If Ten Sixty Six and Light The Night Up avoid a pace duel and one gets first run
scenarios.body: The winner escapes before the prominent pack can organize, with the hold-up horses left too much to do. Light The Night Up's recent form gives her the edge over Ten Sixty Six.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runner finds gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy runners gets a clean passage through the traffic
scenarios.body: Box Clever or Spacewoman thread between horses to strike while others are still scrimmaging. Their race fitness and positioning prove decisive over the closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast in opening half-mile and compound quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole with midfield/prominent runners best placed. Those who traveled kindly in behind the pace battle inherit the race.

watchPoints.text: Ten Sixty Six and Light The Night Up must be monitored early - if they go too fast together both will stop quickly
Box Clever, Spacewoman, Valkyrie Storm and Adba will create a wall of horses in behind the leaders - watch for traffic problems
Galileo Charm and Reem Rak need clear runs from their hold-up positions to be competitive
Jamie Sommers has been inconsistent recently and needs to settle better than last time to be effective
Light The Night Up's 5lb claim from Jack Nicholls could prove decisive if the pace sets up right

runners_data.name: Winchurch

runners_data.name: Ishe Worth Agamble
runners_data.note: Long 100-day absence could bring improvement, but needs a strong pace to be effective from his hold-up position.

runners_data.name: Orbital Chime
runners_data.note: Best recent form with a second at this course, tongue-tie first time suggests connections expect improvement.

runners_data.name: King David
runners_data.note: Consistent performer but lacks a recent win, and Saffie Osborne's 7lb claim helps with the weight burden.

runners_data.name: Big Apple Jack

runners_data.name: Phoenix Moon
runners_data.note: Only front runner with recent winning form over course and distance, perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup.

races.paceDynamic: Phoenix Moon is the only confirmed front runner in this seven-horse field and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate a sustainable pace from the front. The entire field comprises hold-up horses who will settle behind Phoenix Moon's uncontested lead, creating a tactical race where positioning and timing become crucial. With no pace pressure, Phoenix Moon can control the gallop and kick clear when ready, while the hold-up brigade faces the challenge of making up ground from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the early leader Phoenix Moon, as uncontested front runners possess a significant tactical advantage over fields full of closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Phoenix Moon Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Moon gets his uncontested lead and dictates fractions.
scenarios.body: He can quicken when ready from the front while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in a tactically run race. His recent winning form at this trip gives him the confidence to make all.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and Phoenix Moon ties up late.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred strong gallop and can unleash their finishing kicks. Winchurch and Orbital Chime have shown good recent form and benefit from this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Benefits Mid-Range
scenarios.trigger: If Phoenix Moon goes steady but maintains enough pace to blunt closers.
scenarios.body: Horses with tactical speed like King David and Beaming Light can position closer and have less ground to make up. Their versatility allows them to adapt better than pure hold-up types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to fire and an unconsidered runner benefits from the pace.
scenarios.body: Big Apple Jack or Ishe Worth Agamble could benefit from a truly-run race after lengthy breaks. Their freshness and lower expectations could see them outrun their odds.

watchPoints.text: Phoenix Moon getting an uncontested lead - if he jumps well and settles in front unopposed, he becomes very hard to pass
How quickly the hold-up horses begin their moves - if they leave their run too late behind a slow pace, they won't get there
Orbital Chime's early positioning - with his tongue-tie first time and good recent form, his placement could be crucial
Big Apple Jack's fitness after 181 days off - any signs of ring-rustiness could end his chances quickly
The pace through the first two furlongs - if Phoenix Moon goes too steady, it sets up the closers perfectly

races.paceDynamic: Sea Her Excel looks the only natural front runner with Bold Return and Saeculamation likely to race prominently early, creating a sustainable gallop rather than a fierce burn-up. The large field of 15 contains predominantly hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop, but with limited early speed this could become a tactical affair. The moderate early pace will allow the prominent racers to dictate terms and potentially stretch the field in the final two furlongs. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those who can track the pace rather than horses needing a strong gallop to bring out their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Her Excel and Bold Return establish an uncontested lead without pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the front division to control the race and kick clear when ready, leaving the hold-up horses with too much ground to make up. Prominent racers who can travel kindly behind the leaders gain the perfect position to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as hold-up horses start to close
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates gaps for horses with tactical speed to exploit, particularly those who can quicken from mid-division. Late runners get their preferred strong gallop but face a stiff task.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes very slow with multiple horses still in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final furlong with positioning crucial, favouring horses drawn well who can find a clear run. Hold-up horses benefit from the lack of early pace but face traffic problems.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Her Excel and Bold Return go too fast early and tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up the race perfectly for genuine hold-up horses who can stay on strongly past fading leaders. Late finishers get their ideal scenario despite the limited early pace setters.

races.paceDynamic: Layla Liz will lead uncontested from the gates, setting a steady tempo with no other natural front runners to pressure her early. Master Of My Fate, Michaela's Boy, Grandlad and Smart Vision will create a wall of prominent runners behind, likely causing traffic problems and interference in the crucial 2-3 furlong range as they all seek racing room simultaneously. The hold-up horses Muker, Nogo's Dream, Nad Alshiba Green, Desert Cop and Intervention will need significant luck to weave through this congestion in a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader and early prominent runners who can secure clear racing room before the late scramble begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Layla Liz Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Layla Liz maintains her usual strong pace judgment and the prominent pack gets tangled up behind her.
scenarios.body: The leader exploits the tactical advantage while the chasing pack suffers interference, allowing her sustainable gallop to prove decisive. Her recent 5f form at this track gives her the perfect platform to utilise the pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Delivers
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the ideal pitch just behind Layla Liz without getting trapped.
scenarios.body: Master Of My Fate or Smart Vision break clear of the traffic to challenge the leader, with their class and tactical positioning proving crucial in the final furlong. The hold-up brigade arrives too late as the race is decided between the early pace angles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Navigate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and racing room opens up for the back markers in the final 2f.
scenarios.body: Nad Alshiba Green and Desert Cop find clear passages to unleash their finishing kicks, benefiting from the slower overall time and clean runs. The early leaders pay for their efforts as class tells in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Interference
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or severe bumping occurs in the prominent pack creating a lottery finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test rather than a pure speed contest, with any horse avoiding trouble having winning chances regardless of their natural running style. Form and ratings become secondary to luck and jockey skill in navigating the mayhem.

watchPoints.text: Master Of My Fate, Michaela's Boy, Smart Vision and Grandlad will create a dangerous bottleneck 2-3f out as they simultaneously seek racing room
Muker's 215-day absence combined with his hold-up style makes him vulnerable to being outpaced early
Layla Liz's early fractions will determine if the hold-up horses have any realistic chance of getting involved
Nad Alshiba Green and Desert Cop need the pace to be stronger than likely given the tactical setup
Any significant interference in the prominent pack will completely reshape the finish and create a lottery

races.paceDynamic: That's Amore will take this race on from the front with no other confirmed leaders in the field. It's A Heartbeat may sit prominent early but lacks the speed to pressure the leader, allowing That's Amore to dictate fractions through the opening mile. The four hold-up horses (See The Fire, Love Dynasty, Lava Stream, Alla Stella) will be bunched together off the pace, relying on a strong finish over the final two furlongs. This controlled tempo clearly favours front-running tactics, as That's Amore can stretch the field when ready without having burned energy in early pace battles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If That's Amore maintains steady fractions without early pressure

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If It's A Heartbeat can pressure That's Amore early
scenarios.body: The prominent runner forces faster fractions that compromise the leader's stamina reserves. This tactical battle opens the door for a horse sitting just off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If That's Amore goes too slow and gets swamped
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure class trumps tactics. The highest-rated closers benefit from the shortest possible sprint home.

See The Fire's 175-day absence may leave her short of peak race fitness despite highest rating

races.paceDynamic: Macari and Just An Hour are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead over this extended 1m6f trip. Both leaders have the stamina to sustain their gallop, creating an honest tempo throughout rather than a sprint finish. With four hold-up horses (Imperial Sovereign, Codiak, Spirit Of Jura, Rock N Roll Pinkie) tracking behind the dual pace angle, the race sets up perfectly for the closers. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can finish decisively off the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders maintain honest fractions and tire in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The sustained pace plays into the hands of the four hold-up horses who can time their runs perfectly. Imperial Sovereign and Rock N Roll Pinkie benefit most from their class edge in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Duel Too Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Macari and Just An Hour engage in a fierce early battle for the lead
scenarios.body: The aggressive pace burns out both front runners, creating an even stronger setup for the closers with superior finishing kicks. Codiak's recent winning form makes him the primary beneficiary of the collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Just An Hour or Macari establishes an uncontested lead while the other drops back early
scenarios.body: The lone leader can dictate more manageable fractions and prove difficult to peg back over the extended trip. Just An Hour's superior recent form gives him the edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are restrained early creating unexpectedly slow fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of pace disadvantages the natural hold-up horses who need something to aim at in the straight. This scenario favours horses who can adapt tactically and quicken from closer positions.

races.paceDynamic: Shady Bay is the sole confirmed front runner but has been off for 174 days and may lack peak fitness early. With three hold-up horses (Solanna, Kurios Lady, It's Only Fun) and Glint Of Light also likely to settle behind, the pace could be too slow initially. This creates a race where Shady Bay may get an easy lead through steady fractions before quickening late. The combination of a potentially uncontested leader and multiple closers sets up perfectly for prominent runners who can track the pace and have first run on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Shady Bay gets an easy lead and finds enough fitness to sustain his kick
scenarios.body: The long absence means he travels smoothly through soft fractions before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. His early tactical advantage proves decisive as the closers leave their runs too late on ground that's riding a shade slower.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and one hold-up horse produces a superior turn of foot
scenarios.body: Solanna or Kurios Lady benefit from a dawdling gallop that plays into their hands perfectly. The race becomes a sprint from the furlong pole where class and acceleration matter more than position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Glint Of Light positions perfectly behind Shady Bay and quickens before the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The 5lb claimer gets the ideal trip tracking the leader while the closers are still gathering momentum. His recent form on similar ground gives him the edge when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Back

The early pace development - with only one natural leader this could become a crawl that changes the entire complexion

Solanna's ability to get competitive early - her hold-up style needs others to set it up but she has the class to capitalize
